label: A frame with one origin edge between distinct beings and no exercises separates the origin bridges
paraphrase: Closed mathematical control: in the frame on Bool where true originates false and nothing originates itself, with an empty type of exercises, the self-edge origin bridge holds (vacuously, there being no self-origin edge) and the universal origin bridge fails (the edge true to false has no exercise). A statement about this finite interpretation only, not a claim that real origination lacks productive exercises.
